summary: Full backend + frontend testing for AADRIQUE marketing site. 14/14 backend pytest cases pass (services, industries, case studies, posts, faqs, contact incl. honeypot & validation, enquiries persistence). Frontend flows validated: home hero+capability grid (12 tiles = 11 cards + CTA), capability detail navigation (ai-consulting shows Discover/Assess/Recommend/Enable process + FAQs), industries list -> healthcare detail, /work filter reduces 4 cards to 1 for a sector then case study detail loads, /insights shows 5 rows + search + article detail with share, /faq accordion (12 triggers) expands, contact form field validation shows all 3 error testids, contact submit accepted (backend persistence already covered), theme toggle switches html class light<->dark, mobile menu opens showing 6 nav links, privacy-policy and terms both render (>6KB each) with 'updated' hint.

issues: Submit button 'Send enquiry' renders with dark background and near-invisible dark text in light theme when disabled/submitting — poor contrast (see screenshot)

action_items: (Optional/minor) Improve 'Send enquiry' submit button contrast in light theme; currently button text is nearly invisible on dark-on-light rendering.

(Minor) contact-service-select uses native <option> element; get_by_role('option').click was not directly clickable via UI overlay — not a functional bug but worth noting for accessibility (form still submits fine without a service selected).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: honeypot returns 200 without an id which is fine but keep behavior parity documented.
In-memory _rate limiter dict is per-process; will not scale across multiple workers. Acceptable for MVP.
seed_database re-seeds on SEED_VERSION change — deletes existing collections including case_studies/posts. Any manually added data would be lost. OK for a marketing content site.
Contact.jsx uses sonner toast for success; toast auto-dismisses quickly — consider showing an inline success state for better UX/testability.
seed_data_creation: Two test enquiries were created via /api/contact (TEST_User uitest+one honeypot attempt filtered). Persisted docs have TEST_ prefix for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 14 backend pytest cases pass at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Loading screen (sessionStorage 'aadrique-intro') fires once per session for ~2.1s — always sleep 3-3.5s after first page load. Rate-limit is 5 contact posts/min per IP; be mindful when re-running contact tests. Native <option> in service select can't be interacted via role click reliably in Playwright; use page.select_option if needed.
